items.title: Mickey Roker interviewed by Michael Woods, Majesty of the Seas, May 31, 1995
items.q: You know how Little Jimmy Scott sings? You know how Little Jimmy Scott sings behind the beat?

ctx.x: I mean you have to think ahead.

Oh I think everybody should think ahead. If you read, you have to read ahead. You can’t be playing here and reading here, you’ve got to see that and then you’re looking over here you know what I’m saying? But as far as playing, the drummer and the bass player should be just like this, just like one person. And it gives the soloists, they can play behind the beat. You know how Little Jimmy Scott sings? You know how Little Jimmy Scott sings behind the beat? And you see horn players can do that and piano players.…
